instruction: Two-Story Workflow Simulation This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio two-story simulation model and save the required outputs as result.osm, workflow.osw, and run/eplusout.sql. 1. The output folder contains result.osm with size at least 500 bytes, workflow.osw with size at least 50 bytes, and run/eplusout.sql with size at least 1000 bytes. 2. Result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10. 3. Result.osm contains exactly 2 OS:BuildingStory objects, 6 OS:Space objects, and 6 OS:ThermalZone objects. 4. The OS:Space names are exactly Ground North, Ground South, Ground East, Upper North, Upper South, and Upper East. 5. Every OS:Space references an OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2. 6. The model has exactly 38 OS:Surface objects: 6 Floor surfaces, 6 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 26 Wall surfaces. 7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 3 Ground, 17 Outdoors, and 18 Surface. 8. The model has exactly 14 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 14. 9. The model contains exactly 6 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 6 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and 6 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects. 10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 16.00 m, Y span 14.00 m, and Z span 7.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m. 11. The sum of floor surface areas is 448.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 420.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 13. The total fixed-window area is 92.40 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 14. Workflow.osw is valid JSON and contains the top-level keys seed_file, weather_file, measure_paths, steps, and run_options, with at least 1 step. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
